title: Waycine project
description: A Waycine project file (.waycine.json), schema version 1, as of Waycine 0.1.0. Every setting except version and stops is optional and defaults to the value given here. Generated from the settings catalog by scripts/gen-docs.mjs.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editors.

version.description: Schema version of the file. This schema describes version 1.

name.title: Project name
name.description: Name of the project; exported files are named after it.

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Stops in video order, at most 99; at least one must be visible.

items.description: One stop. Only city, lat and lon are needed.

id.title: Stop id
id.description: Stable identifier of the stop, used by the app and in links.

city.title: City
city.description: Place name shown on the card and next to the pin.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Degrees north (negative for south). Unit: deg.

lon.title: Longitude
lon.description: Degrees east (negative for west). Unit: deg.

event.title: Event
event.description: Line under the city on the stop card.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Optional last day; the card then shows a date range.

dateText.title: Date text
dateText.description: Free text shown instead of the formatted date, on the card and the pin.

partner.title: Extra line
partner.description: Optional credit or partner line on the stop card.

region.title: Region
region.description: State or province as shown, for example MA; counted by the regions stat.

regionCode.title: Region code
regionCode.description: Region key used to count regions, for example US-MA.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US; counted by the countries stat.

durationSec.title: Stop length
durationSec.description: Overrides the stop length for this stop only. Unit: s.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Leave this stop out of the video (no pin, route leg, card or stat).

results.title: Results
results.description: Result lines on the stop card.

items.description: One result line of the stop card (and medal dots on the pin label).

medal.title: Medal
medal.description: Medal drawn before the result and as dots next to the pin.

text.title: Result
text.description: Result line on the card, drawn exactly as typed.

count.title: Medal count
count.description: Number of medal dots next to the pin for this result.

text.description: Text templates and date formats. Templates may contain tokens such as {stops|STOP|STOPS}.

title.title: Title
title.description: Shown at the start over the whole route.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Line under the title. Use Insert to add live counts such as stops or kilometres.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional extra line under the subtitle, for example your team or trip name; leave it empty to hide it.

descriptionAt.title: Show description
descriptionAt.description: Show the description only in the intro, or also at the end under the stats.

kicker.title: Stop label
kicker.description: Small line above each city, for example STOP 01 / 07.

cardDate.title: Card date format
cardDate.description: Date format on the stop card: YYYY, MM, DD, M, D and MMM are replaced.

pinDate.title: Pin date format
pinDate.description: Date format next to each pin; leave empty to hide pin dates.

rangeSeparator.title: Date range separator
rangeSeparator.description: Text between the first and last day of a stop with an end date.

pinDateJoin.title: Shared pin date separator
pinDateJoin.description: Joins the dates of stops at the same place on one pin label.

uppercase.title: All caps
uppercase.description: Render titles, cities, events and labels in capital letters; result lines stay as typed.

solid.title: Solid text
solid.description: Draw all text fully opaque, without fade-ins; shapes still fade.

id.title: Theme
id.description: Built-in theme the colours came from, or custom.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Map grid lines, grid labels and the corner marks.

glow.title: Glow
glow.description: Colour of the soft glow around the route.

pin.title: Pin halo
pin.description: Halo and pulse rings around each pin.

pinCore.title: Pin centre
pinCore.description: Solid dot at the centre of each pin.

text.title: Text
text.description: Titles, cities, events, card lines and big numbers.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Subtitle, stop labels, dates, card bar and stat labels.

flash.title: Flash
flash.description: Colour the zoom-through fades into between stops (unless it fades into the background).

fonts.description: Fonts per role: display (titles, cities, numbers) and body (the other texts).

family.title: Font family
family.description: Font used for this role; the bundled fonts are WaycineDisplay and WaycineBody.

weight.title: Font weight
weight.description: Nominal weight of the font; for information only.

source.title: Font source
source.description: Bundled font, or a font uploaded on this device.

sizeAdjust.title: Font size scale
sizeAdjust.description: Multiplies every text size drawn with this font (width and height). Unit: x.

widthAdjust.title: Font width scale
widthAdjust.description: Stretches or narrows every text drawn with this font; heights stay the same. Calibrated for the chosen font; reset it to 1 when you change the font. Unit: x.

family.title: Font family
family.description: Font used for this role; the bundled fonts are WaycineDisplay and WaycineBody.

weight.title: Font weight
weight.description: Nominal weight of the font; for information only.

source.title: Font source
source.description: Bundled font, or a font uploaded on this device.

sizeAdjust.title: Font size scale
sizeAdjust.description: Multiplies every text size drawn with this font (width and height). Unit: x.

widthAdjust.title: Font width scale
widthAdjust.description: Stretches or narrows every text drawn with this font; heights stay the same. Calibrated for the chosen font; reset it to 1 when you change the font. Unit: x.

overviewSec.title: Intro length
overviewSec.description: Seconds of the opening overview. Unit: s.

stopSec.title: Stop length
stopSec.description: Seconds spent on each stop. Unit: s.

finaleSec.title: Finale length
finaleSec.description: Seconds of the closing pull-back with stats. Unit: s.

endHoldSec.title: End hold
endHoldSec.description: Seconds to hold the last frame at the end of the video. Unit: s.

enabled.title: Show intro
enabled.description: Start with the overview of the whole route.

routeEndFrac.title: Route draw time
routeEndFrac.description: Share of the intro by which the route reaches the last stop. Unit: frac.

pushIn.title: Intro push-in
pushIn.description: How much the camera zooms in during the intro. Unit: frac.

titleFadeSec.title: Title fade-in
titleFadeSec.description: Seconds the title takes to fade in. Unit: s.

pulseWindow.title: Intro pulse window
pulseWindow.description: How long, in stops of route travel, a pin pulses after the route reaches it.

pulseRate.title: Intro pulse speed
pulseRate.description: Pulse progress per stop of route travel during the intro. Unit: x.

outroSec.title: Intro fade-out
outroSec.description: One-file videos only: seconds the route, pins and title fade out before stop 1. Unit: s.

flyFrac.title: Flight share
flyFrac.description: Share of each stop spent flying in from the previous stop. Unit: frac.

zoomFrac.title: Zoom-through share
zoomFrac.description: Share of each stop spent zooming into the pin (zoom-through only). Unit: frac.

pinLightAt.title: Pin lights at
pinLightAt.description: Point of the flight, as a share, at which the pin appears and pulses. Unit: frac.

pulseDurFrac.title: Stop pulse length
pulseDurFrac.description: Length of the pin pulse as a share of the stop. Unit: frac.

labelDelaySec.title: Card delay
labelDelaySec.description: Seconds after a stop starts before its card appears. Unit: s.

labelFadeSec.title: Card fade-in
labelFadeSec.description: Seconds the card takes to slide and fade in. Unit: s.

cardFadeOutSec.title: Card fade-out
cardFadeOutSec.description: Fly transition only: seconds the card takes to fade out at the end of a stop. Unit: s.

mode.title: Transition
mode.description: Zoom through each pin into a flash, or fly between stops.

zoomGain.title: Zoom depth
zoomGain.description: How far the zoom-through dives into the pin. Unit: x.

zoomExp.title: Zoom curve
zoomExp.description: Shape of the zoom-through acceleration; higher starts slower.

blurMax.title: Zoom blur
blurMax.description: Blur at the end of the zoom-through. Unit: Du.

blurExp.title: Blur curve
blurExp.description: Shape of the blur build-up; higher starts later.

whiteStart.title: Flash starts
whiteStart.description: How far into the zoom the flash begins, as a share of the zoom. Unit: frac.

whiteExp.title: Flash curve
whiteExp.description: Shape of the flash build-up; higher starts later.

recoverSec.title: Flash length
recoverSec.description: How long the picture takes to fade back after the cut (one-file videos only). Unit: s.

flashTo.title: Flash into
flashTo.description: What the zoom between stops fades into: the flash colour (white unless you change it), or the background colour for a dip to dark.

enabled.title: Show finale
enabled.description: End with the pull-back and stats.

cameraEndFrac.title: Finale camera time
cameraEndFrac.description: Share of the finale the camera takes to pull back. Unit: frac.

pulseStart.title: Finale pulse start
pulseStart.description: Share of the finale after which the pins pulse. Unit: frac.

pulseDur.title: Finale pulse length
pulseDur.description: Length of each finale pulse as a share of the finale. Unit: frac.

pulseStagger.title: Finale pulse stagger
pulseStagger.description: Delay between the pulses of consecutive pins.

pinLabelsAfter.title: Finale labels after
pinLabelsAfter.description: Pin labels show once the finale camera has moved this share of the way. Unit: frac.

statsStart.title: Stats start
statsStart.description: Share of the finale after which the stats appear. Unit: frac.

statsDur.title: Stats duration
statsDur.description: Share of the finale over which the stats appear. Unit: frac.

statsRate.title: Stats speed
statsRate.description: How quickly each stat fades in. Unit: x.

stampZoom.title: Stop zoom
stampZoom.description: How far each stop zooms in, relative to the overview. Unit: x.

flyZoomOut.title: Flight zoom-out
flyZoomOut.description: How much the camera zooms out in the middle of a flight. Unit: frac.

finaleZoom.title: Finale zoom
finaleZoom.description: Zoom at the end of the finale, relative to the overview. Unit: x.

minSpanDeg.title: Minimum map span
minSpanDeg.description: Smallest area the overview shows, in degrees (single stops, city trips). Unit: deg.

flyEasing.title: Movement easing
flyEasing.description: Curve of camera moves and the route draw.

fadeEasing.title: Fade easing
fadeEasing.description: Curve of fades, the card slide, rings and stats.

zoomInterp.title: Zoom blending
zoomInterp.description: Blend zoom levels in straight steps (linear) or evenly by scale (log).

route.description: The route line and its glow.

show.title: Show route
show.description: Draw the route line and its glow.

coreWidth.title: Line width
coreWidth.description: Width of the route line. Unit: Du.

glowWidth.title: Glow width
glowWidth.description: Width of the glow stroke before it is blurred. Unit: Du.

glowBlur.title: Glow blur
glowBlur.description: Softness of the route glow. Unit: Du.

glowOpacity.title: Glow strength
glowOpacity.description: Opacity of the route glow. Unit: alpha.

bulge.title: Curve bend
bulge.description: How strongly each leg of the route arcs; 0 is straight. Unit: frac.

bulgeSide.title: Curve side
bulgeSide.description: Side of travel the route arcs bend to.

samples.title: Curve samples
samples.description: Points per route leg; more is smoother.

pins.description: Pins, pulse rings and pin labels.

radius.title: Pin size
radius.description: Radius of the pin dot. Unit: Du.

haloPad.title: Halo size
haloPad.description: How far the halo extends beyond the pin dot. Unit: Du.

haloAlpha.title: Halo opacity
haloAlpha.description: Opacity of the halo around each pin. Unit: alpha.

rings.title: Pulse rings
rings.description: Start offsets of the pulse rings in pulse progress (the project file may list up to 4).

ringStart.title: Ring start size
ringStart.description: Radius of a pulse ring when it starts. Unit: Du.

ringGrow.title: Ring growth
ringGrow.description: How much a pulse ring grows. Unit: Du.

ringWidth.title: Ring width
ringWidth.description: Line width of the pulse rings. Unit: Du.

ringAlpha.title: Ring opacity
ringAlpha.description: Opacity of a pulse ring when it starts. Unit: alpha.

medalShine.title: Medal shine
medalShine.description: Strength of the highlight on medals. Unit: alpha.

ringMedalWidth.title: Ring medal width
ringMedalWidth.description: Outline width of ring medals, as a share of their radius. Unit: frac.

show.title: Show pin labels
show.description: Show the city and date next to each pin.

placement.title: Label placement
placement.description: Auto moves each label to the place around its pin that best clears the route and the other labels. Fixed keeps every label beside its pin.

dx.title: Label distance
dx.description: Horizontal distance of the label from its pin. Unit: Du.

cityDy.title: Label city height
cityDy.description: Vertical position of the city label relative to the pin. Unit: Du.

dateDy.title: Label date height
dateDy.description: Vertical position of the date label relative to the pin. Unit: Du.

citySize.title: Label city size
citySize.description: Text size of the city next to each pin. Unit: Du.

cityTracking.title: Label city spacing
cityTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of pin city labels. Unit: Du.

dateSize.title: Label date size
dateSize.description: Text size of the date next to each pin. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: Label opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of pin labels (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

medalGap.title: Medal dot gap
medalGap.description: Space between the date and the first medal dot. Unit: Du.

medalR.title: Medal dot size
medalR.description: Radius of the medal dots next to pins. Unit: Du.

medalStep.title: Medal dot spacing
medalStep.description: Distance between neighbouring medal dots. Unit: Du.

medalDy.title: Medal dot height
medalDy.description: Vertical position of the medal dots relative to the pin. Unit: Du.

medalAlpha.title: Medal dot opacity
medalAlpha.description: Opacity of the medal dots. Unit: alpha.

show.title: Show cards
show.description: Show a card with the details of each stop.

showKicker.title: Show stop label
showKicker.description: Show the small stop label above the city.

showEvent.title: Show event
showEvent.description: Show the event line on the card.

showDate.title: Show date
showDate.description: Show the date line on the card.

showPartner.title: Show extra line
showPartner.description: Show the partner or credit line on the card.

showResults.title: Show results
showResults.description: Show result lines with medals on the card.

slide.title: Slide distance
slide.description: How far the card slides in from the right. Unit: Du.

backdrop.title: Backdrop
backdrop.description: How much the route and the grid dim under the card, so no line runs through its text. 0 draws no backdrop. Unit: alpha.

leaderAlpha.title: Pointer opacity
leaderAlpha.description: Opacity of the line from the pin to the card. Unit: alpha.

leaderWidth.title: Pointer width
leaderWidth.description: Width of the line from the pin to the card. Unit: Du.

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Width of the accent bar beside the card. Unit: Du.

barDx.title: Bar position
barDx.description: Horizontal position of the accent bar on the card. Unit: Du.

dx.title: Stop label x
dx.description: Horizontal position of the stop label on the card. Unit: Du.

dy.title: Stop label y
dy.description: Vertical position of the stop label on the card. Unit: Du.

size.title: Stop label size
size.description: Text size of the stop label. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Stop label spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the stop label. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: Stop label opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of the stop label (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

dx.title: City x
dx.description: Horizontal position of the city on the card. Unit: Du.

dy.title: City y
dy.description: Vertical position of the city on the card. Unit: Du.

size.title: City size
size.description: Text size of the city. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: City spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the city. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: City opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of the city (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

minSize.title: City smallest size
minSize.description: Smallest size a long city may shrink to. Unit: Du.

shrinkStep.title: City shrink step
shrinkStep.description: Size removed per step while a long city shrinks to fit. Unit: Du.

fitMaxW.title: City width limit
fitMaxW.description: Widest the city may be before it shrinks: 0 or less counts from the frame width (-170 is the width minus 170), more than 0 is a fixed width. Unit: Du.

measureTracking.title: City fit counts spacing
measureTracking.description: Include letter spacing when checking whether the city fits.

dx.title: Event x
dx.description: Horizontal position of the event on the card. Unit: Du.

dy.title: Event y
dy.description: Vertical position of the event on the card. Unit: Du.

size.title: Event size
size.description: Text size of the event. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Event spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the event. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: Event opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of the event (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

minSize.title: Event smallest size
minSize.description: Smallest size a long event may shrink to. Unit: Du.

shrinkStep.title: Event shrink step
shrinkStep.description: Size removed per step while a long event shrinks to fit. Unit: Du.

fitMaxW.title: Event width limit
fitMaxW.description: Widest the event may be before it shrinks: 0 or less counts from the frame width (-170 is the width minus 170), more than 0 is a fixed width. Unit: Du.

measureTracking.title: Event fit counts spacing
measureTracking.description: Include letter spacing when checking whether the event fits.

dx.title: Date x
dx.description: Horizontal position of the date on the card. Unit: Du.

dy.title: Date y
dy.description: Vertical position of the date on the card. Unit: Du.

size.title: Date size
size.description: Text size of the date. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Date spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the date. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: Date opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of the date (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

rowsY.title: Rows start
rowsY.description: Vertical position where the extra line and result rows start. Unit: Du.

dx.title: Rows x
dx.description: Horizontal position of the extra line and result rows. Unit: Du.

size.title: Rows text size
size.description: Text size of the extra line and result rows. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Rows spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the extra line and result rows. Unit: Du.

alpha.title: Rows opacity
alpha.description: Opacity of the extra line and result rows (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

partnerLineH.title: Extra line height
partnerLineH.description: Line height of the extra line. Unit: Du.

resultRowH.title: Result row height
resultRowH.description: Line height of result rows stacked one per line. Unit: Du.

medalR.title: Result medal size
medalR.description: Radius of the medals on result rows. Unit: Du.

medalDx.title: Result medal x
medalDx.description: Horizontal position of the medal on a result row. Unit: Du.

medalDy.title: Result medal y
medalDy.description: Vertical position of the medal on a result row. Unit: Du.

textDx.title: Result text x
textDx.description: Horizontal position of the result text after its medal. Unit: Du.

inlineGap.title: Result gap
inlineGap.description: Space between results written on one line. Unit: Du.

base.title: Bar height
base.description: Height of the accent bar before extra lines and results. Unit: Du.

perResult.title: Bar per result
perResult.description: Extra accent bar height for results. Unit: Du.

show.title: Show stats
show.description: Show the big numbers during the finale.

labelSize.title: Stat label size
labelSize.description: Size of the words after the numbers. Unit: Du.

labelTracking.title: Stat label spacing
labelTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the stat labels. Unit: Du.

items.title: Stats
items.description: Finale stats in order. Items without a value are left out.
One finale stat: a computed number (or your own value) and a label.

source.title: Stat
source.description: What the number counts; custom shows your own value.

label.title: Stat label
label.description: Word after the number, for example STOPS.

labelOne.title: Label for one
labelOne.description: Word used when the number is exactly 1, for example STOP.

value.title: Own value
value.description: Shown instead of the counted number (required for custom stats).

show.title: Show grid
show.description: Draw the latitude and longitude grid.

stepMode.title: Grid spacing
stepMode.description: Pick the spacing automatically from the zoom, or use a fixed step.

fixedStep.title: Fixed grid step
fixedStep.description: Grid spacing in degrees when the spacing is fixed. Unit: deg.

targetSpacing.title: Grid target spacing
targetSpacing.description: Automatic spacing aims for grid lines about this far apart. Unit: Du.

zoomSplit.title: Grid refine zoom
zoomSplit.description: The grid spacing halves once the camera zooms in this far past the overview. Unit: x.

maxSubdiv.title: Grid refinements
maxSubdiv.description: How many times the grid spacing may halve as the camera zooms in.

lineWidth.title: Grid line width
lineWidth.description: Width of the grid lines. Unit: Du.

minorAlpha.title: Minor line opacity
minorAlpha.description: Opacity of unlabelled grid lines. Unit: alpha.

majorAlpha.title: Major line opacity
majorAlpha.description: Opacity of labelled grid lines. Unit: alpha.

labels.title: Grid labels
labels.description: Label the major grid lines with their degrees.

clearLabels.title: Keep grid labels apart
clearLabels.description: Leave out a grid label that would touch a corner mark or another grid label.

labelSize.title: Grid label size
labelSize.description: Text size of the grid labels. Unit: Du.

labelAlpha.title: Grid label opacity
labelAlpha.description: Opacity of the grid labels (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

lonLabelOffset.title: Longitude label position
lonLabelOffset.description: Longitude labels: distance right of their line, and distance from the top of the frame. Unit: Du.

latLabelOffset.title: Latitude label position
latLabelOffset.description: Latitude labels: distance from the left of the frame, and distance below their line. Unit: Du.

labelFormat.title: Grid label style
labelFormat.description: Plain (72W) or with a degree sign.

corners.title: Corner marks
corners.description: Draw the bracket marks in the corners of the frame.

cornerLen.title: Corner mark length
cornerLen.description: Length of each arm of the corner marks. Unit: Du.

cornerMargin.title: Corner mark inset
cornerMargin.description: Distance of the corner marks from the frame edges. Unit: Du.

cornerWidth.title: Corner mark width
cornerWidth.description: Line width of the corner marks. Unit: Du.

cornerAlpha.title: Corner mark opacity
cornerAlpha.description: Opacity of the corner marks. Unit: alpha.

aspect.title: Format
aspect.description: Landscape 16:9, portrait 9:16, square 1:1, 4:5 or a custom size.

shortSide.title: Video size
shortSide.description: Default size for Export video; you can change it there. Unit: px.

supersample.title: Extra smooth
supersample.description: Render at twice the size and scale down (slower). Unit: x.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Which layout to use; Auto picks it from the format.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Default quality for Export video (higher makes bigger files); you can change it there.

bitrateMbps.title: Bitrate
bitrateMbps.description: Exact bitrate in Mbps; 0 uses the quality setting. Unit: Mbps.

exportMode.title: Export as
exportMode.description: One continuous video, or separate clips per part.

width.title: Custom width
width.description: Width in pixels when the format is custom (even, 320 to 4096). Used when output.aspect is "custom". Unit: px.

height.title: Custom height
height.description: Height in pixels when the format is custom (even, 320 to 4096). Used when output.aspect is "custom". Unit: px.

layouts.description: Geometry per layout profile. The active profile follows output.layout (auto picks by aspect).

marginX.title: Overview side margins
marginX.description: Total space left and right of the route in the overview. Unit: Du.

marginY.title: Overview top and bottom margins
marginY.description: Total space above and below the route in the overview. Unit: Du.

nudgeDeg.title: Overview nudge
nudgeDeg.description: Moves the overview camera by degrees of longitude and of map height. Unit: deg.

nudgeMaxFrac.title: Nudge limit
nudgeMaxFrac.description: Largest nudge as a share of the route span, so small trips stay on screen. Unit: frac.

offsetDu.title: Overview offset
offsetDu.description: Moves the fitted route away from the frame centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

stopPin.title: Stop pin position
stopPin.description: Where the pin sits on screen at each stop, from the frame centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

x.title: Title x
x.description: Left edge of the title, subtitle and description. Unit: Du.

y.title: Title y
y.description: Top of the title. Unit: Du.

size.title: Title size
size.description: Text size of the title. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Title spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the title. Unit: Du.

subY.title: Subtitle y
subY.description: Top of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subSize.title: Subtitle size
subSize.description: Text size of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subTracking.title: Subtitle spacing
subTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subAlpha.title: Subtitle opacity
subAlpha.description: Opacity of the subtitle relative to the title (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

minSize.title: Title smallest size
minSize.description: Smallest size a long title may shrink to. Unit: Du.

subMinSize.title: Subtitle smallest size
subMinSize.description: Smallest size a long subtitle may shrink to. Unit: Du.

shrinkStep.title: Title shrink step
shrinkStep.description: Size removed per step while a long title, subtitle or description shrinks to fit. Unit: Du.

descY.title: Description y
descY.description: Top of the description line. Unit: Du.

descSize.title: Description size
descSize.description: Text size of the description line, in the intro and in the finale. Unit: Du.

descTracking.title: Description spacing
descTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the description. Unit: Du.

descAlpha.title: Description opacity
descAlpha.description: Opacity of the description relative to the title (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

descMinSize.title: Description smallest size
descMinSize.description: Smallest size a long description may shrink to. Unit: Du.

placement.title: Card placement
placement.description: Card to the right of the pin, or below it from the left edge.

x.title: Card x
x.description: Right of the pin: distance from the pin; below the pin: distance from the left edge. Unit: Du.

dy.title: Card y
dy.description: Vertical distance of the card from the pin. Unit: Du.

leader.title: Pointer shape
leader.description: Line from the pin to the card: diagonal or vertical.

leaderFrom.title: Pointer start
leaderFrom.description: Start of the pointer line, from the pin centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

leaderTo.title: Pointer end
leaderTo.description: End of the pointer line, from the card corner or below the pin (right, down). Unit: Du.

results.title: Result rows
results.description: Results side by side on one line, or one per line.

partnerWrapChars.title: Extra line wrap
partnerWrapChars.description: Split the extra line in two when it is longer than this many characters; 0 never splits. Unit: chars.

barPartner.title: Bar for extra line
barPartner.description: Extra accent bar height when a stop has an extra line. Unit: Du.

resultsBarPerRow.title: Bar grows per result
resultsBarPerRow.description: Grow the accent bar for every result row, instead of once.

order.title: Label drawing order
order.description: Draw each label right after its pin, or all labels after all pins.

flipAboveX.title: Flip labels after
flipAboveX.description: Labels of pins right of this share of the width go on the left of their pin; empty flips a label only when it would run off the frame. With Label placement on Auto this is only the side a label prefers. Unit: frac.

medals.title: Medal dots on labels
medals.description: Show medal dots after the date on pin labels.

x.title: Stats x
x.description: Left edge of the first finale stat. Unit: Du.

y.title: Stats y
y.description: Top of the first finale stat. Unit: Du.

direction.title: Stats arrangement
direction.description: Stats side by side in a row, or stacked in a column.

pitch.title: Stats spacing
pitch.description: Distance between neighbouring stats. Unit: Du.

numberSize.title: Stats number size
numberSize.description: Text size of the big numbers. Unit: Du.

labelDx.title: Stats label x
labelDx.description: Horizontal position of each stat label from its number. Unit: Du.

labelDy.title: Stats label y
labelDy.description: Vertical position of each stat label from the top of its number. Unit: Du.

top.title: Safe area top
top.description: Top margin of the safe-zone guide, as a share of the height. Unit: frac.

right.title: Safe area right
right.description: Right margin of the safe-zone guide, as a share of the width (preview only). Unit: frac.

bottom.title: Safe area bottom
bottom.description: Bottom margin of the safe-zone guide, as a share of the height. Unit: frac.

left.title: Safe area left
left.description: Left margin of the safe-zone guide, as a share of the width (preview only). Unit: frac.

marginX.title: Overview side margins
marginX.description: Total space left and right of the route in the overview. Unit: Du.

marginY.title: Overview top and bottom margins
marginY.description: Total space above and below the route in the overview. Unit: Du.

nudgeDeg.title: Overview nudge
nudgeDeg.description: Moves the overview camera by degrees of longitude and of map height. Unit: deg.

nudgeMaxFrac.title: Nudge limit
nudgeMaxFrac.description: Largest nudge as a share of the route span, so small trips stay on screen. Unit: frac.

offsetDu.title: Overview offset
offsetDu.description: Moves the fitted route away from the frame centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

stopPin.title: Stop pin position
stopPin.description: Where the pin sits on screen at each stop, from the frame centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

x.title: Title x
x.description: Left edge of the title, subtitle and description. Unit: Du.

y.title: Title y
y.description: Top of the title. Unit: Du.

size.title: Title size
size.description: Text size of the title. Unit: Du.

tracking.title: Title spacing
tracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the title. Unit: Du.

subY.title: Subtitle y
subY.description: Top of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subSize.title: Subtitle size
subSize.description: Text size of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subTracking.title: Subtitle spacing
subTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the subtitle. Unit: Du.

subAlpha.title: Subtitle opacity
subAlpha.description: Opacity of the subtitle relative to the title (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

minSize.title: Title smallest size
minSize.description: Smallest size a long title may shrink to. Unit: Du.

subMinSize.title: Subtitle smallest size
subMinSize.description: Smallest size a long subtitle may shrink to. Unit: Du.

shrinkStep.title: Title shrink step
shrinkStep.description: Size removed per step while a long title, subtitle or description shrinks to fit. Unit: Du.

descY.title: Description y
descY.description: Top of the description line. Unit: Du.

descSize.title: Description size
descSize.description: Text size of the description line, in the intro and in the finale. Unit: Du.

descTracking.title: Description spacing
descTracking.description: Extra space between the letters of the description. Unit: Du.

descAlpha.title: Description opacity
descAlpha.description: Opacity of the description relative to the title (solid text ignores it). Unit: alpha.

descMinSize.title: Description smallest size
descMinSize.description: Smallest size a long description may shrink to. Unit: Du.

placement.title: Card placement
placement.description: Card to the right of the pin, or below it from the left edge.

x.title: Card x
x.description: Right of the pin: distance from the pin; below the pin: distance from the left edge. Unit: Du.

dy.title: Card y
dy.description: Vertical distance of the card from the pin. Unit: Du.

leader.title: Pointer shape
leader.description: Line from the pin to the card: diagonal or vertical.

leaderFrom.title: Pointer start
leaderFrom.description: Start of the pointer line, from the pin centre (right, down). Unit: Du.

leaderTo.title: Pointer end
leaderTo.description: End of the pointer line, from the card corner or below the pin (right, down). Unit: Du.

results.title: Result rows
results.description: Results side by side on one line, or one per line.

partnerWrapChars.title: Extra line wrap
partnerWrapChars.description: Split the extra line in two when it is longer than this many characters; 0 never splits. Unit: chars.

barPartner.title: Bar for extra line
barPartner.description: Extra accent bar height when a stop has an extra line. Unit: Du.

resultsBarPerRow.title: Bar grows per result
resultsBarPerRow.description: Grow the accent bar for every result row, instead of once.

order.title: Label drawing order
order.description: Draw each label right after its pin, or all labels after all pins.
